notes.title: Crystal Guardians early access release!
notes.content:
Hello all,

Very excited to share with you that the game has been released into early access!!! (for 1 day now)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322090/Crystal_Guardians/

[h1]Differences between Prologue/Demo and early access[/h1]

[h3]New and upgraded visuals[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ce60XWH.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vcyuyhJ.png[/img]

[h3]4 Modes, 2 with 2 lanes and the hardest going up to wave 100![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sUXa9Mq.png[/img]
Can you beat the final boss in hard-mode at wave 100?

[h3]Explore 30 new items[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xKOzh8v.png[/img]
Explore new OP combinations and find your best build!

[h3]Explore the bigger and improved progression menu[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MOAOnwE.png[/img]
Many new paths and builds to explore and try out

[h3]Defeat the 6 new bosses[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CYpblwP.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/A9kEv6s.png[/img]

[h3]Enemies have new capabilites, modifiers and abilities[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z7jSlL3.png[/img]

And much more to come with regular updates planned!
Leave feedback in the discord (link) or steam discussion page.
New ideas about improvements or new content are also appreciated! :)

Hopefully you have a great time playing the game

- Tim

notes.title: Update 4, Steam next fest participation and the future for updates
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you![/h2]
This will (probably) be the last update I will upload for the prologue. Thank you all for all the feedback, nice comments, sharing highlights and the ideas! 
These allowed me to make the necessary QoL improvements and bug fixes before releasing the game in ~3 weeks. 

[h2]Next Fest[/h2]
On the 5th of February, Steam next fest starts and I will be participating. [b]Playing the demo and sharing it would really help me out a great deal!![/b]
As for updates, I will probably only update the demo, but the updates will only contain QoL improvements and bug fixes. So no extra content updates!

[h2]Future updates[/h2]
As mentioned, I will only be updating the demo from now on. These updates will mostly consist of some balancing, QoL updates and bugs. I still look at all the feedback and ideas given in the discord and the discussion pages!

[h2]Update 4[/h2]
Here are the changes I made for this update, maybe I forgot to list some.

- Added a recipe book
- Added more visibility when building a new tower, can also be turned off in the Game Options
- When zooming out, it the type of tower and crystal to give you a better overview
- Updated the look of the voxels a bit, added a bit of color variation
- You can now swap crystals from one tower to another
- Increased the difficulty of hardmode a tad
- Added a section to the handbook about status effects like DOT, bleeding, slow etc.
- Added Windowed mode option!


Fixed various bugs/inconsistencies
- Fixed issue with leaderboard not loading when fast pressing buttons
- Fixed issue with game over damage not being accurate
- Fixed issue with boxing glove
- Fixed issue where the continue button would still show up after winning/losing
- Fixed the issue with not unlocking the big burger when receiving 3 sandwiches
- Fixed a bug when re-rolling and sorting that would result in different outcomes
- Fixed the bug where when loading into a game, the screen would go from windowed to full screen.
- Fixed more bugs that I forgot to write down...


[h3]The new look![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QiIEqkI.png[/img]

[h3]Building mode[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cK2DgIe.png[/img]

[h3]Progression descriptions[/h3]

notes.title: Update 3.5
notes.content:
This update is a bit on the larger side since I changed the video you see in the main menu. The video is now more up-to-date with the current gameplay!

Additional changes made:
- Corrected the damage numbers, now the damage stats of tower should be accurate
- Enabled option to skip and re enable the tutorial if desired
- Fixed handbook mistake in item recipes section
- Added some more info to the handbook
- Made the tutorial a bit more clear now
- Added naming to the progression trees (crystal only branches)
- Added 3 new leaderboards: Biggest tower damage, highest DOT stack, highest single hit damage
- Boxing glove now also saves stats when the game is saved
- Removed the ability to reload the game in order to power game the item rolls
- Fixed the meteor strike item
- Fixed the executioner item, now it will also display the "executed" text when an enemy gets executed

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Thanks for all the feedback and thanks for playing![/h2]

This update took me a bit longer since I had to test a bunch of things and had less time available.
I made a bunch of QOL updates, redesigning certain things and adding more information in the handbook. 
Total damage done at the end of the game per tower should now also be way more accurate.

- Fixed the bug where the biggest damage hit was 900 000 000
- Fixed the horseshoe bug where the progression critical chance would override the item
- Fixed a bug where projectile towers dealt 200% damage
- Naming consistency Firethrower
- Damage done should be way more accurate now

- Adjusted burn to expire in 5 seconds from the last time it was applied to the enemy and compute damage based on that
- Adjusted bleed to expire in 6 seconds from the last time it was applied to the enemy and compute damage based on that

- Redesigned the health bar and handbook
- Added enemies and item recipes to the handbook
- You can now resize the UI from the menu!
- Tower gets selected when panning to the tower via tower overview
- Entire progression tree is now visible from the start
- Increased the speed of item rolling a bit more
- Show kills made per tower in tower overview
- Decreased the bloom a bit for the rain tower, no more intense light show

- Buffed recipe Bigger Bombs
- Buffed recipe Glacial Aura

Enemies information in handbook
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SaozFLC.jpg[/img]


UI redesign health bar
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TyKdTdm.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.5
notes.content:
Hello all, I've made a couple of changes to the UI and listened to all your feedback. Tried to fix most of them but some are still in the making. Thanks for all the feedback!

- Upgraded the UI for certain parts a bit, to make it look more consistent
- Now you can also press right mouse button in the progression menu to drag the screen
- Made item roll animation a bit faster
- Slowing chackels -> Slowing shackles
- Added item rarity colors in the Item catalogue
- Change the progression colors a bit to match the crystal better
- Fixed the lag spike you got when opening tower overview when there were lots of towers

Progression fixed colors to represent the color of the crystals
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tbSz5fh.png[/img]

UI small update to make it look more in line with the game
[img]https://i.imgur.com/o1C5fAf.png[/img]

- Removed the pause menu exploit

- Fixed bug with item recipe Magma explosion not working on flamethrower
- Fixed the in-game timer that was hidden at the start all the time

- Buffed DOT overall
- Buffed item Slow power
- Buffed the explosive barrels, the barrel now also shows damage numbers when it hits!

notes.title: Update 1 hotfix 2
notes.content:
Thank you to all the people reporting bugs and suggesting ideas in the discord and on the discussion page! It's greatly appreciated :) 

[h3][b]And thanks to all the people that left a review, those help me out a lot![/b][/h3]

[h2]Here are the fixes/changes:[/h2]
- Decreased the amount of particles spawning when boulder tower uses seismic slam, should get rid of the lag spikes
- Fixed a couple bugs regarding the stone of attack speed and stone of damage. (this took some time, but it they should work perfect now!)
- Fixed a bug where you could level all tower abilities when having 1 tower hit level 10
- Re-balanced the waves 20-30 and 30-40 (not the boss waves!)
- Changed names to Flamethrower
- Added a timer, can be enabled in the game settings in-game (it's turned off by default!!)
- Added the ability to zoom in via - and + key, also added this to the tutorial
- Fixed the bug where you get an achievement for a boss wave while dying to it

notes.title: Update 1 hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with scrolling in the tower overview menu, now it doesn't zoom the camera anymore!!
- Fixed various spelling and grammar errors and made item descriptions more clear
- Fixed issues with bombs leaving left over damage numbers
- Fixed issues with bombs being clicked while building a bomb, and through the UI
- Fixed mouse not returning from hand when hovering tower targetting
- The max firerate is 20, now the number in the tower info menu becomes blue when reaching max!
- Escape can close menu now
- Projectile tower now should always kills it's target instead of leaving them at very low HP

Thanks to the discord users for reporting the bugs! Make sure to leave a review if you enjoy the game, that helps me out a ton!

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
[h1]Changes made[/h1]

- fixed a bug where you could spent a point on an already unlocked progression item
- fixed a bug with progression menu scaling
- Made scaling on higher resolution screens better
- Fixed camera shake not going down to 0
- Hardmode ability for the last boss was bugged, not anymore!
- Added a missle for hardmode Gilbert
- The horseraid boss mode now also drops a worthy soldier from the horse instead of a weakling
- Redesigned the handbook a bit
- Created the tower overview menu
- Made shortcuts for the towers and crystals hopefully a bit more intuitive
- Added 3 new short cuts for [R]olling all random items, [F] for sorting main inventory, and [T] to open the Tower Overview

[h2]Tower overview[/h2]

Now you can get a quick overview of all the towers in your game, where your items are and what towers lack a crystal. By pressing the camera in the overview, it will take you to the tower.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ogkz4cu.png[/img]

[h2]Handbook[/h2]

The handbook gives and explains all sorts of useful information. It can be found in the settings in game. Press the gear button in the top left and it will be in the drop down!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EdlWAij.png[/img]

[h2]Shortcuts[/h2]

Hopefully the shortcuts are now a bit more intuitive from the start. I also added a couple of new short cuts like rolling all the items in your inventory and sorting them!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xmCfUSQ.png[/img]

That's all for this update, maybe I forgot to mention some changes.
And if you find any more bugs, please fill the form that you can find in the bottom right of the main menu
